title: pultenaea lanceolata
intro: Pultenaea lanceolata, commonly known as Lance-leaf Bush Pea, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is native to Australia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its potential use in treating wounds and infections. Pultenaea lanceolata contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
